jobs.description:
Hos AVdesign i Billund søger vi en erfaren produktionskoordinator til et barselsvikariat i vores videoteam.

Du skal være god til at planlægge, holde overblik og få produktionerne til at hænge sammen – også når der kommer ændringer undervejs. Du får tæt kontakt med vores kunder og kolleger og deltager både i koordineringen og de praktiske opgaver i studiet og på location.

Om jobbet

Du får en central rolle i planlægningen og gennemførelsen af vores produktioner. Vi arbejder med video, livestreaming, produktoptagelser i studiet og andre medieproduktioner. Opgaverne varierer, og du skal have lyst til at hjælpe til, hvor der er brug for dig.

Vi søger dig, der har erfaring som producer, produktionsleder eller koordinator og er vant til at holde styr på planer, mennesker og deadlines.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

• 
Planlægge og koordinere produktioner i samarbejde med teamet.

• 
Holde styr på tidsplaner, logistik og praktiske aftaler.

• 
Have løbende kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere og sikre, at de er godt informeret undervejs.

• 
Deltage i produktionerne og hjælpe med praktiske og kreative opgaver.

• 
Følge op på opgaver og sørge for, at projekterne bliver leveret til tiden.

• 
Håndtere ændringer og finde løsninger, når noget ikke går som planlagt.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden, idéer og erfaringer.

Om dig

Du arbejder struktureret, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og kolleger og kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver skal løses samtidig.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

• 
Har erfaring med koordinering, projektarbejde, administration eller produktionsplanlægning.

• 
Er god til at planlægge og holde styr på flere projekter og deadlines.

• 
Er omhyggelig og har øje for detaljerne.

• 
Tager ansvar og selv følger op på det, der mangler.

• 
Kan tilpasse dig, når planer og prioriteringer ændrer sig.

• 
Har lyst til en hverdag med forskellige opgaver og både koordinering og praktisk arbejde.

• 
Er en god kollega, der samarbejder og hjælper til.

Erfaring med video, livestreaming eller broadcast er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder lettere billedbehandling, videoredigering eller grundlæggende grafisk arbejde. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Om AVdesign

AVdesign er en international produktionsvirksomhed i Billund, grundlagt i 2005. Vi er 16 kolleger inden for blandt andet animation, filmproduktion, lyd og produktionsledelse og løser opgaver for kunder over hele verden.

Du bliver en del af vores videoteam på seks personer. Vi går op i vores fag, godt samarbejde og muligheden for at udvikle os både fagligt og personligt.

Vi deler lokaler med My Instore Radio og er samlet 26 kolleger med forskellige nationaliteter.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Arbejdsstedet er Billund, og stillingen kræver fysisk fremmøde.

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til application@avdesign.dk. Har du spørgsmål, er du også velkommen til at skrive.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når stillingen er besat.

Would you like to combine your engineering studies with practical experience in project management and learn how technical solutions and business priorities come together?

At Gram Equipment, we develop and deliver equipment for industrial ice cream production worldwide. We are looking for an engineering student to join our Project Management team in Kolding, either as an intern or a student worker.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues and gain insight into how we coordinate projects, from technical requirements and planning to delivery. Along the way, you will learn how mechanical solutions, customer expectations, budgets and deadlines influence project decisions.

What you will be doing
You will support our project managers in their daily work, with tasks adapted to your skills, interests and study requirements. Your tasks may include:

• Supporting project planning and following up on milestones, deadlines and outstanding actions.
• Preparing and updating project documentation, status reports and meeting materials.
• Participating in project meetings and following up on agreed actions.
• Helping coordinate activities across Engineering, Sales, Production, Installation and Service.
• Supporting the follow-up on project costs, changes and risks.
• Contributing ideas to improve project processes and ways of working.

As you develop your understanding of our projects, you will have the opportunity to take responsibility for defined tasks with guidance from the team.

Who we are looking for
You are studying Mechanical Engineering, Global Business Engineering or a related engineering programme. You have a good understanding of mechanical principles and an interest in the business side of engineering, particularly how technical decisions affect costs, delivery and customer value.

We also imagine that you:

• Are curious about project management and eager to apply your knowledge in practice.
• Work in a structured way and follow through on your tasks.
• Enjoy collaborating with people across different functions.
• Take initiative and ask questions when you need input.
• Communicate clearly in English, both spoken and written.
You do not need previous project management experience. What matters is your willingness to learn and contribute.

What we offer
You will gain practical experience in an international engineering company, with support and feedback from experienced project managers. You will work on real projects and develop your technical, commercial and coordination skills.

Our main office in Kolding offers an informal working environment with dedicated colleagues.

Looking for an internship? We will agree on the duration, scope and learning objectives in line with your study programme.

Looking for a student job? We will agree on working hours that fit in with your studies, with flexibility during exam periods.

Interested?

Please send your CV and a short application explaining your motivation. Let us know whether you are interested in an internship, a student job or either option, and include your preferred start date and availability.

jobs.description:
Department of Biology at the Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen is offering an Assistant Professor position in Biology commencing 01.01.2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Description of the scientific environment

  The Andersen-Colombani group at the Department of Biology, University of Copenhagen, is recruiting a Assistant to work on a 2-year project aiming at understanding the physiological role of TNFR signaling in controlling metabolism and behavior using Drosophila Melanogaster as a model organism. The position is available to start on the 1st of January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The group is housed in the section of Cell and Neurobiology at the Department of Biology (https://www.biocenter.ku.dk/).

  Project Description

  The pathological functions of tumor necrosis factors (TNFs) have received considerable attention in the last two decades due to its implication in driving metabolic diseases associated with chronic inflammatory conditions, such as cancers and type 2 diabetes (T2D). Despite the undisputable role of TNF in promoting T2D, anti-TNF clinical trials on humans with obesity-related T2D have produced conflicting results, suggesting that anti-TNF therapy might have adverse effects targeting homeostasis-promoting TNF functions. Nevertheless, the physiological/beneficial functions of TNF remain largely unexplored. Due to the genetic amenability of Drosophila and a simplified fly TNF-TNF receptor (TNFR) system, flies provide an excellent model for studying the physiological functions of TNF. The advertised project explores the role of TNF/TNFRs in maintaining systemic energy homeostasis and controlling feeding behavior and the complex role that TNF signaling plays in adapting metabolism and behavior to environmental stressors.

  We are seeking highly motivated candidates with a PhD in Biology or a related field, postdoctoral experience, and a strong background in Drosophila gut physiology, behavioural biology, and genetic approaches.

  The assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regard to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within genetics and physiology. To a limited extent this may also include performance of other duties

  Principal supervisors:

  Dr. Ditte Andersen, Department of Biology, Cell and Neurobiology section, ditte.andersen@bio.ku.dk, Direct Phone: +45 27 85 30 22 

  Dr. Julien Colombani, Department of Biology, Cell and Neurobiology section, julien.colombani@bio.ku.dk, Direct Phone: +45 27 84 76 66.

  Qualifications/Selection criteria

   	
• Applicants should hold a PhD degree in Biology 	
• Having prior experience with the Drosophila model and Genetics is essential 	
• Having a solid background in metabolism and behavior is an advantage 	
• Strong motivation and very good scientific skills are essential 	
• Having demonstrated the ability to conduct high-impact research 	
• Having shown the ability to attract external funding is an advantage 	
• Teaching qualifications are not mandatory, but teaching and supervision experience will be considered.   Six overall criteria apply for assistant professor appointments at the University of Copenhagen. The six criteria (research, teaching, societal impact, organisational contribution, external funding and leadership) are considered a framework for the overall assessment of candidates. Furthermore, each candidate must be assessed according to the specific requirements stated in the job advertisement. Please read more at https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/dokumenter-til-meritering/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf .

  Further information on the Department can be found on the Department of Biology website.

  The position is open from 01.01.2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

jobs.occupation: Head of Dosimetry - DTU Health Tech
jobs.description:
Lead a unique scientific and application-driven facility delivering internationally recognised industrial and medical dosimetry expertise. 

DTU Health Tech is seeking an experienced leader to head the Dosimetry facility. The facility is internationally recognised for its expertise in industrial and medical dosimetry and provides accredited calibration, measurement, validation and consultancy services to industry, hospitals, authorities and international partners. The facility includes the High Dose Reference Laboratory (HDRL) and medical dosimetry activities and serves as a trusted provider of radiation measurement and quality assurance services in Denmark and internationally. 

As Head of Dosimetry, you will be responsible for leading and developing a team of approximately 10 highly skilled employees. You will ensure a motivating and inclusive work environment, support the professional development of staff and set the strategic direction for the facility in close collaboration with the Head of the Department and leadership team at Health Technology, DTU.

This position is ideal for a leader who brings solid experience in developing people and teams, and who is motivated by contributing actively to the leadership team at DTU Health Tech. You will help shape the shared direction of the department, strengthen a strong sense of community, and create value across disciplines, functions and stakeholder groups. This position is ideal for a leader who brings solid experience in developing people and teams, and who thrives in a specialised knowledge environment where results are created through trust, clarity and collaboration.

The job
As Head of Dosimetry, you will have overall responsibility for the facility’s people, operations and strategic development. 

Your key responsibilities will include: 

• Setting the professional and scientific direction for the facility, ensuring that its expertise is continuously developed and translated into new opportunities, partnerships and high-quality services.
• Positioning the facility to remain at the international forefront of industrial and medical dosimetry by actively identifying emerging needs, technologies and application areas.
• Leading the facility in accordance with DTU's leadership principles, fostering trust, collaboration, accountability and professional excellence. 
• Exercising visible and engaging people leadership for a team of approximately 10 employees. 
• Supporting employee well-being, performance, competence development and engagement. 
• Ensuring the continued development and delivery of high-quality dosimetry services and scientific expertise. 
• Maintaining and developing collaborations with industrial customers and partners, healthcare organisations, authorities[CF3] and international stakeholders. 
• Ensuring compliance with accreditation, quality assurance and regulatory requirements. 
• Managing resources, budgets and operational priorities. 
• Supporting innovation, business development and opportunities arising from Dosimetry’s research and technical capabilities. 
• Strengthening collaboration with other departments and research environments within DTU. 
Our expectations of you
We are looking for an experienced leader with a PhD degree and relevant working experience within dosimetry, combined with a strong motivation to develop people, build a collaborative team culture and contribute to the broader development of DTU Health Tech.

You likely bring: 

• Demonstrated experience with people leadership and responsibility for employee development, performance and well-being. 
• Experience leading teams of highly specialised professionals in a knowledge-intensive organisation. 
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to build trust and motivation across diverse employee groups. 
• Experience with strategic planning, stakeholder management and organisational development. 
• A collaborative leadership style aligned with DTU's values and leadership approach. 
• A PhD degree or equivalent qualifications within medical and industrial dosimetry.
• Leadership experience from a university or a research institution.
• Experience with accredited laboratories, quality management systems and regulated environments. 
What we offer in return
At DTU Health Tech, you will join an ambitious and collaborative organisation dedicated to developing technologies that improve health and quality of life. 

You will lead a facility with a strong international reputation, highly competent employees and a unique combination of scientific excellence and societal impact. [CF7] The position offers a significant opportunity to influence the future development of a strategically important area within DTU Health Tech. The facility delivers internationally traceable dosimetry services, supports radiation processing and sterilisation activities, and maintains long-standing relationships with industry, healthcare and public-sector stakeholders. 

You will be part of an ambitious and experienced leadership team, and you will report directly to the head of department.

In recent years, DTU has been working concertedly to professionalize management. The DTU Leadership Role is based on four cornerstones: academic management, resource management, Performance-enhancing HR management and strategic management. Moreover, self-management and DTU’s values constitute the central parameters for these four disciplines. To find out more about DTU’s Leadership Role, see the website.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as a Senior Executive Officer with personnel management. 

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for managers (TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 23 October 2026 (23:59). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Head of DTU Health Tech, Helle Waagepetersen, on +45 2381 1664.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Health Tech
DTU Health Tech engages in research, education, and innovation base on technical and natural science for the healthcare sector. The Healthcare sector is a globally expanding market with demands for the most advanced technological solutions. DTU Health Tech creates the foundation for companies to develop new and innovative services and products which benefit people and create value for society. DTU Health Tech’s expertise spans from imaging and biosensor techniques, across digital health and biological modelling, to biopharma technologies. The department has a scientific staff of about 210 people, 140 PhD students and a technical/administrative support staff of about 160 people, of which a large majority contributes to our research infrastructure and related commercial activities.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
